name: Ashizuri-Uwakai National Park
description: National park (1972) at Shikoku's southern tip: Cape Ashizuri's sea cliffs, the Sukumo Bay ria coast and the Uwakai island waters of Ehime.
notes: Designated 1972 (11,345 ha). The cape's coastal path and glass-bottom boats are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)

ja.description: 四国南端にある国立公園（1972年指定）。足摺岬の海食崖、宿毛湾のリアス海岸、愛媛の宇和海の島々が広がる。
